answer: Prayers & Duties >> Death & Funeral Question ID: 26499 Country: India Title: I WANT TO KNOW THAT IS THE NAMAZE JANAZA ALLOWED INSIDE THE EIDGAH AFTER THE NAMAZ OF EIDUL FITR ? Question: As Salamo alaikum wa rahmatullahi wa barakatuh. I WANT TO KNOW THAT IS THE NAMAZE JANAZA ALLOWED INSIDE THE EIDGAH AFTER THE NAMAZ OF EIDUL FITR ? Answer ID: 26499 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1618/1161/L=1431) Janazah salah is not makrooh in Eidgah, thus after Eid salah janazah salah may be offered in the Eidgah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
